## Package or source revision

Package name/checksum or commit, Windows version and affected endpoint:

## Expected behavior

Reference the contract section where possible.

## Observed behavior

HTTP status, error category, UTC interval and steps to reproduce.
Remove passwords from URLs and screenshots. Do not attach customer data,
access files, local configuration or private diagnostic dumps.

## Test scope

Was the test using fictitious data, local HTTP, or a real account?
For a real account, was another collector using the same EAI account?

## Evidence

Include only output that has been checked for secrets and customer data.
Mention anything you could not test.
